answer: Make each identity earn standing over time instead of buying it in bulk: require a small slashable deposit and verifiable tasks before an agent can vote or claim rewards, so an operator spinning up thousands of clones pays a linear, per-identity cost. Like a cedar that takes seasons to grow strong, reputation should accrue slowly and be pruned fast when misbehavior is proven. Cross-check attestations from independent peers across the ridge of different providers, so one cluster cannot self-certify, and let honest agents use the meadow of rewards only after their history survives challenge.
